headline: Vermont's Valcour dispatch system is still offline, and the state still has no timeline for bringing it back.
summary: Re-read the Department of Public Safety's Nov 24 statement (s012) and Nov 20 update (s003): Valcour stays offline until the investigation is complete; no timeline; phone lines and 911 unaffected.
